name: Luna 21
intro: Beep boop! Lunokhod 2 here. Faster, smarter, with a third eye on top.
We land inside Le Monnier, an old crater flooded by lava, near the Apollo 17 valley.
My drivers on Earth want to beat Lunokhod 1's record.
Choose a good parking spot for my lander!
briefing: We are at the edge of Mare Serenitatis.
Pick a site with sunshine and Earth in view.
fact: Lunokhod 2 drove about 39 km: a distance record that lasted over 40 years.
